name: ERP7 Solutions Sync for Odoo and WooCommerce
author: Niraj Gupta

sections.description:
ERP7 Solutions Sync for Odoo and WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store to your Odoo ERP system through the OdooConnector cloud service, with a focus on complete, reliable order synchronization.

What this plugin includes

  • Odoo connection setup and validation
  • Order export (WooCommerce → Odoo): automatic on checkout and on status change, plus manual export
  • Order import (Odoo → WooCommerce)
  • Invoice handling: create Odoo invoices from orders, mark paid / register payments
  • Refund sync: WooCommerce refunds become Odoo credit notes
  • Dashboard, logging, and HPOS-compatible order handling
  • Secure webhook callbacks for sync status

Every feature listed above is fully functional in this plugin — there is no license unlock, trialware gate, or disabled code path.

Pro add-on (separate plugin)

Product synchronization, customer synchronization, and inventory sync are provided by a separate commercial add-on plugin, ERP7 Sync for Odoo Pro, distributed from https://odooconnector.cloud (not from WordPress.org). The Features tab in this plugin shows a plain comparison of what this plugin does versus what the add-on adds.

Trademark notice

“Odoo” is a trademark of Odoo S.A. “WooCommerce” is a trademark of Automattic Inc. This plugin is an independent integration developed by ERP7 Solutions and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Odoo S.A., Automattic Inc., or WooCommerce.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • An Odoo instance (URL, database, username, password)
  • Network access to the OdooConnector service (see “External services” below)

External services

This plugin relies on OdooConnector (https://odooconnector.cloud), a cloud middleware service operated by the plugin author, to perform synchronization between WooCommerce and Odoo. The plugin does not sync to Odoo without it.

What the service does: it receives sync requests from your store, connects to your Odoo instance on your behalf, and executes the operations you request.

Free plan scope: without a paid OdooConnector plan, the service processes up to 10 successful order syncs per calendar month — including invoice and payment handling as part of each order — and may reject further requests with a quota error. Paid service plans enable unlimited order sync on the middleware and are required by the separate Pro add-on for product, inventory, and customer sync. This plugin does not disable its own sync functions when a service limit is reached.

Subscription billing for the service is processed by Stripe.

Data sent to the service:

  • Your site URL — sent automatically, as soon as the plugin is active, to check your subscription status
  • Your Odoo connection details — Odoo URL, database name, username, and password — sent and stored by the service once you enter them and test/save the connection
  • A webhook secret — shared with the service on login/register so sync completion callbacks can be authenticated
  • Your WordPress admin email — sent once you subscribe, used for billing and service notifications
  • The WooCommerce data being synchronized (orders and their customer details) — sent once you connect and sync

By activating the plugin you consent to your site URL being sent for subscription-status checks; by configuring the connection you consent to your Odoo credentials and WooCommerce data being transmitted to and processed by the OdooConnector service.

  • Service website: https://odooconnector.cloud
  • Terms of Use: https://odooconnector.cloud/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://odooconnector.cloud/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/erp7-solutions-sync-for-odoo-and-woocommerce/ (or install via WordPress admin)
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → ERP7 Sync and enter your Odoo URL, database, username, and password, then test the connection
  4. Configure sync preferences and save
  5. Optionally subscribe to the OdooConnector service from the Features tab for unlimited middleware order sync
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a paid service?

Not for typical use. The OdooConnector free plan covers order sync — including invoicing, payment, and refund handling — for up to 10 orders per month (enforced by the service, not by the plugin). Unlimited order sync requires a paid OdooConnector plan. Billing is handled via Stripe on the Features tab when you subscribe.

Are any features locked behind a paid upgrade in the plugin?

No. Everything this plugin ships is fully functional with no license check or feature gate. Product, customer, and inventory sync are not hidden features of this plugin — they are provided by a separate Pro add-on plugin sold on odooconnector.cloud. The Features tab shows the comparison openly.

Which Odoo versions are supported?

The service adapts to your Odoo version through a single unified API. Support for Odoo 16–18-specific features (e.g. Connector Server, API key) is planned for a future version.

Is HPOS supported?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I point the plugin at my own connector instance?

Yes. The middleware URL is configurable, so you are not locked to the hosted service. Either define ERP7SYNC_MIDDLEWARE_URL in wp-config.php before the plugin loads, or open the connection tab with &devmode=true appended to the settings page URL and enter a custom API URL. If the connector becomes unreachable, the plugin fails fast (a built-in circuit breaker pauses connector requests for a few minutes after repeated failures) instead of stalling your site.
sections.changelog:
2.1.2

  • Changed – Pro download and Support links now point at the service domain (wp.odooconnector.cloud)

2.1.1

  • Changed – Plugin scope clarified: this plugin focuses on complete order sync (export, import, invoices, payments, refunds); product/customer/inventory sync moved to the separate Pro add-on
  • Fixed – Order export on checkout: sync classes now load on front-end requests, so checkout hooks (classic and block checkout) fire reliably
  • Fixed – Queue cleanup failed on strict-mode MySQL (invalid DATETIME comparison)
  • Fixed – Order import progress counts included deferred webhook rows, so totals no longer fluctuate
  • Fixed – Invoice ID extraction handles all Odoo response shapes; refunds fall back to an amount-only credit note line when products are unmapped
  • Improved – Settings screens reorganized into cards; dashboard icon alignment; stale progress panels auto-hide
  • Improved – Subscription state reconciles from the service (stale local subscriptions are purged)

1.0.0

  • Initial public release as ERP7 Solutions Sync for Odoo and WooCommerce
  • Order sync through OdooConnector
  • WordPress.org compliance: no trialware or plugin-side feature locks
  • Mandatory webhook secret (hash_equals); guest orders on import
  • Text domain aligned to plugin slug erp7-solutions-sync-for-odoo-and-woocommerce
  • Dashboard, logging, HPOS-compatible order handling
